parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description: The type of the policy. Valid values: `System` and `Custom`.

parameters.name: RoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram detach-policy-from-role --policy-type Custom --policy-name OSS-Administrator --role-name OSSAdminRole --resource-group-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ram DetachPolicyFromRole --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyType Custom --RoleName OSSAdminRole --ResourceGroupId 'example-string' --PolicyName 'OSS-Administrator'
